Description: Solve other modules on the bomb for each of the Houses of Hogwarts. Then calculate their point scores and determine which House wins the House Cup. Tags: banner, module-name, parchment, scroll, Gryffindor, Hufflepuff, Ravenclaw, Slytherin
Name: Hogwarts

Souvenir.Explanation: The modules you solve for each Hogwarts house are completely controlled by the defuser and/or expert. You don't need to know which house every module belongs to either, since only four are required to solve.
